mapper.select: select a.*,e.asset_name as assetName,e.asset_code as code,l.location_name as locationName from ai_alert a left join equipment_assets e on a.equipment_id = e.asset_id left join equipment_location l on e.location_id = l.location_id where a.id = #{id}
select alert_type as alertType, count(*) as numb from ai_alert group by alert_type
